title: 韩国民画装饰
scenePrompt: Original Korean chaekgeori-inspired still-life painting across a few shallow painted shelf compartments: stacks of closed blue and ochre thread-bound books with BLANK unmarked covers, a small white ceramic vase, a pomegranate and a citrus fruit, a modest peony sprig. Flat ink outlines, playful but coherent oblique shelf perspective, mineral-like muted colors on warm paper, decorative early-modern Korean painting sensibility, not Chinese literati ink landscape. No tiger, no modern branded toys. Landscape 3:2, single continuous painting not photographed panel collage. Palette #4D697D #B36E58 #DDC699 #698466. Absolutely no writing, calligraphy, labels, letters, characters, numbers, seals, signatures, borders, logos or swatches.
